## 4. Base rates
- In September, BTC went from about $75,000 on 9/16 to about $81,000 by 9/19-9/20, a move of about 8% in four days. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/bitcoin-price-september-2026)
- A Yahoo/CoinDesk piece said BTC had made higher lows for four months in a row. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/bitcoin-made-higher-lows-four-182039634.html)
- For scale: at BTC's usual annualized volatility of about 40-50% (general knowledge, not checked against a source for 2026), one standard deviation over 10 days is roughly 8-9%. That is about the size of the drop from $81,000 to $75,000.
- I found no formal base rate for a drop of 7% or more within 10 days.
